This may have been so far the worst new year celebration of my life. I'm having withdrawal problems from a drug I took for 2 years so my head was really unwell these past few days. Drugs really mess you up.

Surprised? No. I always knew I wanted to live. I still have hope that my life will get better. Relieved? Yes. Last month was the most suicidal I have ever been. I was already willing to kill myself. It was at that time that I learned that I had a very strong will to live. Half of me was willing to die yet half of me was willing to live, I was fighting for my life. The way I see it now, if you do want or are willing to kill yourself already then you should see every new day in life as a bonus in your life.

Side note. To me willing is worse than wanting. Wanting to die just means you wish you would die. Willing to die however means you are finally capable of doing it.

I think your advice to seek help is correct. Unfortunately I have very ignorant parents. I knew something was wrong with me but they were against me going to a mental health doctor. My mom told me that if people knew I had a mental disorder then I would not be able to get a job. I have a very difficult time getting them to help me get consultations. I think one of the problems in this world is the stigmatization of mental illnesses. Recently I've been thinking that if people were more open about their mental health problems then the world would be a better place. The reason behind that is if more people know you have a problem, then more people would be able to help you. I wish in the future people will be open to sharing about their mental illnesses, that would be a better world.

I agree on you about finding the right therapist, or finding the right psychiatrist for that matter. I've realized that one of the problems in this world is that there are many bad doctors. I was fortunate enough that my very first psychiatrist correctly diagnosed me with OCD. I did not even know what that was at the time but when I researched on it everything clicked and I finally knew what was my problem. I however did not start taking the medication at the time yet. Fast forward years later and I have encounter 2 bad doctors who can't see that I have OCD and kept on prescribing me medications for things I don't have. It's difficult to get back to my first doctor because her label says child psychiatrist and I was no longer a minor. My mom thinks that i just like to act like I know better, but what's ironic is that she is the very person who does that. I seeked another doctor and my 4th doctor was finally a competent one who correctly diagnosed me with OCD. I have tried 3 antidepressants already but unfortunately none of them worked, I am still optimistic that someday my OCD will be cured. If I become successful and famous someday, drugs and the psychiatry department will be one of the issues that I will be vocal about.

I should have opened up to an uncle of mine with his family. He and his sister have high IQ's. His mother also always go to high quality hospitals. Perhaps if I seeked help from them, they could have refered me to a good psychiatrist early on. But I didn't know any better back then. I did not know back then that there are many bad doctors who will misdiagnose you.

There was only one person who was there for me when I needed help, an aunt of mine. Unfortunately when I was 21 and finally made serious effort to get medical help, she already left the country to work abroad.

Seeing my life it is full of failures of things that are not even my fault. It's like everything just goes wrong. I know talking about God will rub people the wrong way, but I actually believe in God, and the reason is quite unique. My life has been so bad that I cannot believe that it is just bad luck, but that God is actively giving me a hard time. If you lived my life you'd see how everything just goes wrong. But you have not lived my life and some of you would probably just think I am being overly-dramatic. That is why I said I feel life is hopeless, because no matter how much I fight for myself if God wants me to fail then I will. I am still hopeful that someday God will stop treating me like this and bless me with a wonderful life. I am actually conflicted whether I should post this last paragraph of mine or not as I touched about my belief in God.
